description: Adds an attachment to a Trello card by `idCard`; specify either a `file` to upload or a `url` to link, but not both.

file.description: Path to the local file to attach if not linking a `url`.
file.title: File

idCard.description: ID or shortLink of the Trello card.
idCard.title: Id Card

mimeType.description: MIME type of the attachment, aiding Trello in file handling. Max length 256.
mimeType.title: Mime Type

name.description: Desired name for the attachment. If omitted, Trello uses the original filename or a URL-derived default. Max length 256.
name.title: Name

url.description: URL of an external resource to attach if not uploading a `file`. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'.
url.title: Url

name: add_cards_attachments_by_id_card

bytes.description: Size of the attachment in bytes (null for URL attachments).
bytes.title: Bytes

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the attachment was created.
date.title: Date

edgeColor.description: Edge color extracted from the attachment image, if applicable.
edgeColor.title: Edge Color

idMember.description: ID of the member who added the attachment.
idMember.title: Id Member

isMalicious.description: Whether the attachment has been flagged as malicious.
isMalicious.title: Is Malicious

isUpload.description: True if the attachment was uploaded as a file, false if it was linked via URL.
isUpload.title: Is Upload

pos.description: Position of the attachment relative to other attachments on the card.
pos.title: Pos

previews.description: List of preview images at various sizes (for image attachments).
previews.title: Previews

url.description: URL where the attachment can be accessed.
url.title: Url
